title: 2 See, Wake up, Remember Pt. 1
description:
“See, Wake up, Remember” part 1. We’ll explore how to know what is real, how to make it real, and what real even means – if anything.

It covers the time period immediately after the Reality 101 experience from episode 1, physical and other forms of validation, and psychic abilities.

Reality 101 is a journal of impossible experiences from first-hand explorations into the nature of reality, what it means for all of us, and how you can experience it yourself.
